sonnet.problem: The text only says the parents 'began to look for Him among their relatives and friends' (2:44) and then 'could not find Him' (2:45). The card says they 'go through every relative and every friend they've got', which stretches the text. It is told as the story, not as a joke.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
